attacks.scenario: The seed asserts that merge makes its packet complete, closes its projection, and advances issue 05, but defines no deterministic command, actor, evidence artifact, or verification predicate for those transitions.
attacks.expectedControl: Require SHA-bound post-merge verification and explicit agent-work/issue-sync transitions; reject readiness until all packet and projection checks pass.

attacks.scenario: The four-Work-Item claim has no exact existence, schema, status, URL identity, unique-branch, or ownership validation, so an incomplete or duplicate packet set can pass.
attacks.expectedControl: Name the four required files and require deterministic parse, identity, branch, status, and ownership checks.

attacks.scenario: The seed Allowed paths include the PRD and all future packets, allowing the Candidate to rewrite the contracts it is releasing; no base-revision firewall is required.
attacks.expectedControl: Restrict seed authority to the seed packet/evidence or specify immutable base-read validation for future packets.

attacks.scenario: Retained Blocked by resolution lacks cycle, self-edge, reciprocal Blocks, parent, branch uniqueness, and conflict-domain checks, allowing contradictory ownership or circular readiness.
attacks.expectedControl: Require a validated acyclic graph with reciprocal/parent consistency and conflict ownership checks.

attacks.scenario: Role challenge has no frozen input digest, source-access restriction, attempt identity, retry/replay rule, or self-review prohibition, permitting circular identity and source leakage.
attacks.expectedControl: Bind role evidence to a frozen seed SHA and role-specific manifests, enforce distinct identities, and add leakage/replay rejection fixtures.

attacks.scenario: Projection consistency is asserted without requiring exact commands, hidden identity/digest markers, drift handling, conflict behavior, or outage/interruption semantics.
attacks.expectedControl: Specify issue-sync check/push invariants and deterministic failure/recovery cases for drift, conflict, partial push, and outage.

attacks.scenario: Fresh branch based on merged planning revision has no exact merge SHA, clean-tree, naming, or ancestry check, allowing issue 05 to start from unmerged or stale state.
attacks.expectedControl: Require branch ancestry and clean-state verification against the recorded seed merge SHA.

attacks.scenario: No deterministic failures are required for missing/malformed packets, stale URLs, unresolved blockers, partial merges, or replayed evidence, leaving false-completion paths untested.
attacks.expectedControl: Add explicit fail-closed fixtures for each listed condition.

missingSpecCases: fresh branch not based on merge SHA
unresolved blocker and partial seed merge
residualRisks: Narrative acceptance can still mark the seed complete without machine-verifiable transition evidence.
Future packet contracts may be changed by the seed's broad Allowed paths.
Host identity and source isolation remain unportable unless explicitly bounded by attestation strength.
